description: Project-Level Dataset on Risk Transfer, Government Guarantees, and Project Distress in Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs), 1990-2024 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Nyame, Prince Elton Dion (Wisconsin International University College, Ghana). This dataset contains 8,742 project-level observations on public-private partnership (PPP) infrastructure projects across 140 low- and middle-income countries in six World Bank regions (East Asia and Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, Middle East and North Africa, South Asia, and Sub-Saharan Africa) over the period 1990 to 2024. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
